Party.name: party_id
Party.description: MANDATORY: Unique ID for your customers. Use a pseudo-ID or an internal customer ID instead of an externally facing customer ID.

Party.name: validity_start_time
Party.description: MANDATORY: Timestamp of when the information in this row reflected the state of the entity and was known to the bank.

Party.name: is_entity_deleted
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: If set to TRUE, indicates the party as deleted from your system of reference.

Party.name: source_system
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Name of the system that this row was fetched from to help manage data lineage. This field has no impact on AML AI functionality.

Party.name: type
Party.description: MANDATORY: Type of this party, to differentiate between a natural person or a legal entity. One of: [COMPANY:CONSUMER].

Party.name: name
Party.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Name of this party.

Party.name: addresses
Party.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Addresses of this party, if any.

fields.name: address_line
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: First line of address in case not captured by street and building number.

fields.name: street
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Street of the address.

fields.name: building_number
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Building number of the address.

fields.name: post_office_box
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: PO Box identifier in case the address is a PO Box.

fields.name: post_code
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Postcode. Include postcode for each Party where this is known to the bank.

fields.name: town
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Town of the address.

fields.name: subregion
fields.description: MANDATORY: Region within the country. For AML do not use NULL for this field.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: Country or region in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format. Do not use NULL for this field.

Party.name: birth_date
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Date of birth for the Party for natural persons, for example, where Party.type = CONSUMER. Where Party.type = COMPANY, use NULL. Typically also used for fairness evaluation.

Party.name: establishment_date
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Party's date of establishment with Party.type = COMPANY. Where Party.type = CONSUMER, use NULL.

Party.name: occupation
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Most recent occupation of the Party, if known. Only relevant with Party.type = CONSUMER. Where Party.type = COMPANY, use NULL. If not known, use the empty string. Note that this field is not intended to capture employment level. For example, for a carpenter who is currently unemployed, this field should read "Carpenter".

Party.name: gender
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Gender string for individuals. Typically used for fairness evaluation.

Party.name: nationalities
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: One or more nationalities for natural persons, with an empty list in exceptional cases when your do not have information on the tax residency of the party. Empty for companies. Typically also used for fairness evaluation.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: Country or region in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format.

Party.name: residencies
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: One or more of the Party's tax residencies (for natural persons), with an empty list in exceptional cases. Empty list for companies.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: Country or region in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format.

Party.name: exit_date
Party.description: MANDATORY: The date when the party stopped being a customer. Use NULL if the Party has not stopped being a customer.

Party.name: join_date
Party.description: MANDATORY: Date when the Party first became your customer. Use NULL if the Party has been entered into your systems but has not yet opened an account.

Party.name: assets_value_range
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Approximate value of assets held by the Party. Where possible, this estimate should include assets held by other financial institutions. Include at least the start or end amount.

fields.name: start_amount
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: The lower bound of the money range (inclusive) or NULL if there is no bound. If provided, it should be positive.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

fields.name: units
fields.description: MANDATORY: The whole units of the amount. For example, if currency_code is USD, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

fields.name: nanos
fields.description: MANDATORY: Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount. The value must be between 0 and 999,999,999, inclusive. Nanos must be positive or zero.

fields.name: end_amount
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: The upper bound of the money range (exclusive) or NULL if there is no bound.  If provided, it should be positive. The range represents a single value when start_amount is equal to end_amount.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

fields.name: units
fields.description: MANDATORY: The whole units of the amount. For example, if currency_code is USD, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

fields.name: nanos
fields.description: MANDATORY: Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount. The value must be between 0 and 999,999,999, inclusive. Nanos must be positive or zero.

Party.name: civil_status_code
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Civil status of the Party, based on ISO 20022 Civil Status Codes. If not known, use UNKNOWN. One of: [SINGLE:MARRIED:LEGALLY_DIVORCED:DIVORCED:WIDOW:STABLE_UNION:SEPARATED:UNKNOWN].

Party.name: phone_numbers
Party.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Zero or more phone numbers of this Party.

fields.name: type
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Type of this phone number. Supported Values: PERSONAL, CORPORATE One of: [PERSONAL:CORPORATE].

fields.name: phone
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Phone number. Either this field or obfuscated_phone should be filled in.

fields.name: obfuscated_phone
fields.description: MANDATORY: Phone number, obfuscated. Do not use NULL for this field.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Region code in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format, if known.

Party.name: email_addresses
Party.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Zero or more email addresses of this Party.

fields.name: type
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Type of this email address. Supported values: PERSONAL, CORPORATE One of: [PERSONAL:CORPORATE].

fields.name: email
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Email address. Either this field or obfuscated_email should be filled in.

fields.name: obfuscated_email
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Email address, obfuscated.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Region code in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format, if known.

Party.name: education_level_code
Party.description: RECOMMENDED: Most recent educational level of the Party, defined in International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED-11). If not known, use UNKNOWN. Based on standard ISCED-Attainment (ISCED-A) coding. One of: [LESS_THAN_PRIMARY_EDUCATION:PRIMARY_EDUCATION:LOWER_SECONDARY_EDUCATION:UPPER_SECONDARY_EDUCATION:POST_SECONDARY_NON_TERTIARY_EDUCATION:SHORT_CYCLE_TERTIARY_EDUCATION:BACHELORS_OR_EQUIVALENT:MASTERS_OR_EQUIVALENT:DOCTORAL_OR_EQUIVALENT:NOT_ELSEWHERE_CLASSIFIED:UNKNOWN].

Transaction.name: transaction_id
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: Unique ID of this transaction, from the point of view of the specified Account. Note that a transfer is between two accounts, both in the Account table, and should be represented by two transactions with separate transaction IDs, one with direction = DEBIT and one with direction = CREDIT.

Transaction.name: validity_start_time
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: Timestamp when the information of this row was the correct state of the entity.

Transaction.name: is_entity_deleted
Transaction.description: RECOMMENDED: If set to TRUE, indicates the Transaction is no longer present in your system of record.

Transaction.name: source_system
Transaction.description: RECOMMENDED: Name of the system that this row was fetched from to help manage data lineage. This field has no impact on AML AI functionality.

Transaction.name: type
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: High level type of the transaction. Supported values: CARD, transaction involving a credit or debit card (includes GPay); CASH, transaction where cash is paid into or withdrawn from an account; CHECK, transaction where a cheque is used; WIRE, default for other transactions, including transfers between accounts at the same or different banks. One of: [WIRE:CASH:CHECK:CARD:OTHER:CRYPTO].

Transaction.name: direction
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: Direction of the transaction assets flow from the point of view of the specified account ID. Uses common definition of credit/debit in banking. Supported values: DEBIT, represents a transfer of value from this account; CREDIT, represents a transfer of value to this account One of: [DEBIT:CREDIT].

Transaction.name: account_id
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: Account ID of the Account in the Account Party Link table.

Transaction.name: counterparty_account
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: Details of counterparty and their account used in this transaction. Relates specifically to WIRE, CASH and CHECK transactions. For CARD transactions, this may represent the merchant or be NULL in case you do not have these details.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: MANDATORY: Account ID of a transaction's counterparty, if in the AccountPartyLink table. Can be NULL if the counterparty account is not represented in the Account Party Link table, for example, the customer of another financial institution.

fields.name: counterparty_name
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Name of the counterparty.

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Counterparty address, if known.

fields.name: address_line
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: First line of address in case not captured by street and building number.

fields.name: street
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Street of the address.

fields.name: building_number
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Building number of the address.

fields.name: post_office_box
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: PO Box identifier in case the address is a PO Box.

fields.name: post_code
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Postcode. Include postcode for each Party where this is known to the bank.

fields.name: town
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Town of the address.

fields.name: subregion
fields.description: MANDATORY: Region within the country. For AML do not use NULL for this field.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: Country or region in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format. Do not use NULL for this field.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: RECOMMENDED: Country or region of the counterparty account in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format. In the case of cash withdrawals or deposits, this should be the country where the cash was withdrawn or deposited.

Transaction.name: book_time
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: The time when the transaction was posted to the account (recommended). You may use a different time if preferred by your internal processes and controls.

Transaction.name: normalized_booked_amount
Transaction.description: MANDATORY: Non-negative booked amount posted on the party's account, normalized to a standard currency for the whole dataset.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.description: MANDATORY: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

fields.name: units
fields.description: MANDATORY: The whole units of the amount. For example, if currency_code is USD, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

fields.name: nanos
fields.description: MANDATORY: Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount. The value must be between 0 and 999,999,999, inclusive. Nanos must be positive or zero.

Transaction.name: ip_address
Transaction.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Ip address from which the transaction was booked.

fields.name: type
fields.description: MANDATORY: IP address type. One of: [V4:V6].

fields.name: ip
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: IP address.

fields.name: obfuscated_ip
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: IP address, obfuscated.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Region code extracted from the IP address in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format, if known.

fields.name: is_vpn
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Whether a VPN service was used.

InteractionEvent.name: interaction_event_id
InteractionEvent.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Unique interaction event ID string.

InteractionEvent.name: account_id
InteractionEvent.description: EXPERIMENTAL: The ID of an account directly related to this event, if any.

InteractionEvent.name: type
InteractionEvent.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Type of the interaction event. Must be one of the enum values. Make sure to check the documentation on this field. One of: [LOGIN:PAYMENT_METHOD_ADDED:KYC_CHANGE:PASSWORD_CHANGE:OTHER].

InteractionEvent.name: event_time
InteractionEvent.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Time when the event happened.

InteractionEvent.name: ip_address
InteractionEvent.description: EXPERIMENTAL: IP address of the device that the Party is using for this interaction.

fields.name: type
fields.description: MANDATORY: IP address type. One of: [V4:V6].

fields.name: ip
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: IP address.

fields.name: obfuscated_ip
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: IP address, obfuscated.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Region code extracted from the IP address in two-letter Unicode CLDR code format, if known.

fields.name: is_vpn
fields.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Whether a VPN service was used.

PartySupplementaryData.name: party_supplementary_data_id
PartySupplementaryData.description: MANDATORY: Identifier for the supplementary data field. This ID should match between Datasets used for the same modeling process (for example, for tuning, training, predict and backtesting steps). IDs may use letters, numbers, and underscores, matching the regular expression [a-zA-Z0-9_]. The first character should be a letter or number, matching the regular expression [a-zA-Z0-9]. With engine versions released prior to 2024-03-01 these IDs must use values from 1 to 100.

PartySupplementaryData.name: validity_start_time
PartySupplementaryData.description: MANDATORY: Timestamp when this record became valid.

PartySupplementaryData.name: is_entity_deleted
PartySupplementaryData.description: RECOMMENDED: If set to TRUE, indicates this supplementary data field no longer has a value for this Party.

PartySupplementaryData.name: source_system
PartySupplementaryData.description: RECOMMENDED: Name of the system that this row was fetched from to help manage data lineage. This field has no impact on AML AI functionality.

PartySupplementaryData.name: party_id
PartySupplementaryData.description: MANDATORY: ID of the Party to which this value of this supplementary data field refers.

PartySupplementaryData.name: supplementary_data_payload
PartySupplementaryData.description: MANDATORY: Payload of the supplementary data; only supports float64 values.

fields.name: value
fields.description: MANDATORY: The value of this supplementary data field. Type: float64.

RiskCaseEvent.name: risk_case_event_id
RiskCaseEvent.description: MANDATORY: Unique ID for this event.

RiskCaseEvent.name: event_time
RiskCaseEvent.description: MANDATORY: Timestamp when this event occurs.

RiskCaseEvent.name: type
RiskCaseEvent.description: MANDATORY: Type of risk case event. Only AML events are supported. The minimum requirement for the AML product to work is to provide a single AML_PROCESS_START, AML_PROCESS_END and where applicable AML_EXIT event per Party and risk_case_id. It is strongly recommended to also include AML_SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_START and AML_SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_END events for best model performance. One of: [AML_SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_START:AML_SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_END:AML_PROCESS_START:AML_PROCESS_END:AML_ALERT_GOOGLE:AML_ALERT_LEGACY:AML_ALERT_ADHOC:AML_ALERT_EXPLORATORY:AML_ALERT_EXTERNAL:AML_SAR:AML_EXIT].

RiskCaseEvent.name: party_id
RiskCaseEvent.description: MANDATORY: The ID in the Party table of the Party that is the subject of this investigation process.

RiskCaseEvent.name: risk_typology_measurements
RiskCaseEvent.description: RECOMMENDED: Information about the measured risks for this event. For SARs and exits, these are the risks identified in the investigation process and justifying the SAR or exit. Typologies specified for any risk case event resulting in an exit are used in measuring risk coverage.

fields.name: risk_typology_id
fields.description: MANDATORY: Unique ID of the risk type being measured.

RiskCaseEvent.name: risk_case_id
RiskCaseEvent.description: MANDATORY: The ID of the overall case to which this event belongs.

AccountPartyLink.name: account_id
AccountPartyLink.description: MANDATORY: Unique ID for this Account.

AccountPartyLink.name: party_id
AccountPartyLink.description: MANDATORY: Unique ID for this Party in the Party table.

AccountPartyLink.name: validity_start_time
AccountPartyLink.description: MANDATORY: Timestamp when the information of this row was in the correct state for the entity.

AccountPartyLink.name: is_entity_deleted
AccountPartyLink.description: RECOMMENDED: If set to TRUE, indicates the link is no longer present.

AccountPartyLink.name: role
AccountPartyLink.description: MANDATORY: Describes how the party is related to the account. In particular, capturing primary and secondary account holders. Each Account should have at least one PRIMARY_HOLDER at any given time. Do not use NULL for this field. Supported values: PRIMARY_HOLDER - a party designated as the main (or joint main) holder of the account. SECONDARY_HOLDER - another party who is not the main account holder but with similar access and similar level of responsibility. SUPPLEMENTARY_HOLDER - any other party with either significantly reduced access or significantly reduced responsibility for the account. One of: [PRIMARY_HOLDER:SECONDARY_HOLDER:SUPPLEMENTARY_HOLDER].

AccountPartyLink.name: source_system
AccountPartyLink.description: RECOMMENDED: Name of the system that this row was fetched from to help manage data lineage. This field has no impact on AML AI functionality.
